name: marketplace
description: AI guidance marketplace — roadmap, canon and orchestration as plain markdown files in your repo, plus 3D level-design taste and method, and a session-recap mod, for Claude Code

plugins.name: roadmap
plugins.description: Roadmap + canon as markdown files in the repo (.claude/roadmap.md, .claude/canon/), plus three agent roles: the `scribe` entry point talks with you, reframes, asks and keeps canon + roadmap; the `orchestrateur` scopes, delegates each task to an executor at the right reasoning effort, verifies on return and reports back; executors code. Each agent pins its own model in its file; an optional advisor corrects the smaller executors. No MCP server required

plugins.name: level-design
plugins.description: 3D level-design taste and method, engine-agnostic: read the brief, set four dials (openness, density, relief, nature), ban the AI's defaults (square outlines, tiled floors, sprinkled props, lamp carpets, rainbow palettes), pass a measurable pre-flight; a build procedure (measured reference recipes, spec with questions, idempotent build pass, audits, fixed captures, honest delivery) and a level-design-reviewer agent that judges screenshots against the project's canon

plugins.name: session-recap
plugins.description: Session recap mod (function hooks, tested on Claude Code 2.1.287; the mods API is early access): a pane (/session-recap) and a one-line band show the starting agent, a per-prompt timeline of subagents (new, resumed, forked), each agent's resolved model and effort, tokens by agent × model × effort, and the 5-hour / 7-day limits with a forecast; toasts warn on limit thresholds, token budgets, an unexpected model or a main agent eating the session. Read-only: it never blocks or rewrites anything
